rationale: In _do_adaptive_clipping the EMA update lerps grad_norm_exp_avg toward max_norm_ratio*EMA itself instead of the actual current grad norm — a self-referential update that converges to a fixed point. Both buggy and correct code call lerp_ with finite arguments; only the target operand differs. No standard trace field exposes the lerp source operand. Detection requires source-level inspection or op-level hook on the specific lerp_ call. Per anti-example 9, source-only bugs are pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.
